title: Vitamin D Assay Testing

criteria.summary: Documented reason for a repeat test within 12 months

passages.text: This policy applies to outpatient claims for 25-hydroxy vitamin D testing, CPT 82306, with dates of service on or after January 1, 2026.
Vitamin D testing is considered reasonable and necessary when criteria 3.1 and 3.2 are both met. Criterion 3.2 is met for a first test in 12 months.
A qualifying condition is documented: chronic kidney disease stage 3 to 5, a malabsorption disorder, osteoporosis, hypocalcemia, or monitoring of treatment for documented vitamin D deficiency.
When the test repeats a vitamin D test performed within the previous 12 months, the record documents a reason: a prior abnormal result followed by a change in treatment, or new symptoms.

Documentation supporting each applicable criterion must be available in the medical record on request. Absence of documentation for a required criterion does not establish that the criterion was not met.
